z-m-15-05.title: Yiyiphi igrafu enhle yokubonisa idatha efanayo?
z-m-15-05.goal: Qhathanisa ukuthi uhlobo ngalunye lwegrafu lubonisa kahle ezinye izinto futhi lubi kwezinye, bese ukhetha igrafu ehambisana nenhloso, unikeze izizathu.
z-m-15-05.material:
Umtapo wolwazi wesikole wenza inhlolovo yenani lezincwadi ezibolekwe inyanga ngayinye kusuka kuMashi kuya ku-Agasti.
UMashi 350, u-Ephreli 380, uMeyi 420, uJuni 300, uJulayi 410, u-Agasti 560 (isamba sezinyanga eziyi-6: 2420)
Sifuna ukubonisa le datha kugrafu. Ku-pie chart, asibhali inani lezincwadi noma isamba, kuphela usayizi wezigaba namagama ezinyanga, futhi izigaba zibekwe ngokulandelana kusukela enkulu.
z-m-15-05.thinking.0: Ukuqhathanisa nokuhlola izindlela zokubonisa idatha ukuze zihambisane nenhloso
z-m-15-05.thinking.1: Ukuhlukanisa lokho igrafu elikubonisayo nalokho ikufihlayo
z-m-15-05.prereq.0: Ukwazi ukufunda ama-line graph nama-bar graph (izinga leBanga 4)
z-m-15-05.prereq.1: Ukwazi ukuthi i-circle graph noma i-band graph ibonisa isilinganiso sezingxenye kwiyonke (izinga leBanga 6)
z-m-15-05.s.s1.prompt: Ufuna ukubonisa ngokubuka kanye ukuthi inani lezincwadi ezibolekwe kusukela kuMashi kuya ku-Agasti lashintsha kanjani (ukugeleza kokukhuphuka nokwehla). Iyiphi igrafu efaneleke kakhulu?
z-m-15-05.s.s1.hint.0: Sho emshweni owodwa ukuthi lokho ofuna ukukubonisa ngu-'amangaki inyanga ngayinye' noma u-'kushintshe kanjani njengoba izinyanga zihamba.'
z-m-15-05.s.s1.hint.1: Cabanga igrafu ngayinye engqondweni bese uqhathanisa ukuthi ushintsho olusuka kuMeyi kuya kuJuni luyabonakala yini.
z-m-15-05.s.s1.r.a: Le grafu ibonisa ingxenye yenyanga ngayinye yeyonke. Ayifanele ukubonisa ukugeleza kokukhuphuka nokwehla njengoba izinyanga zihamba.
z-m-15-05.s.s1.r.b: Kuhle ukuqhathanisa osayizi inyanga ngenyanga. Ukubonisa ukugeleza, i-line graph ingase ihambisane kangcono.
z-m-15-05.s.s1.r.c: Le grafu yehlukanisa iyonke ibe yishidi elilodwa ukubonisa izingxenye. Kunzima ukubonisa isiqondiso soshintsho ezinyangeni.
z-m-15-05.s.s1.r.d: Wakhumbula ukuthi ingrafu ebonisa inani eliguquka ngokuhamba kwesikhathi ngokukhuphuka nokwehla komugqa.
z-m-15-05.s.s1.explain: Ukubonisa ukuthi amanani aguquka kanjani njengoba isikhathi sihamba, i-line graph iqondile kakhulu. I-bar graph nayo ingaqhathanisa inyanga ngenyanga, kodwa i-line graph ibonisa ngokucace kakhulu umugqa ukhuphuka futhi wehla njengoba uxhumana.
z-m-15-05.s.s1.acc.0: I-bar graph nayo ilula ukuqhathanisa inyanga ngenyanga, futhi ukukhuphuka nokwehla kungafundwa ebudeni bamabha. Nokho, isiqondiso nosayizi woshintsho kubonakala ngokucace kakhulu ngokubuka kanye ekuthambekeni komugqa kwi-line graph.
z-m-15-05.s.s2.prompt: Uma idwetshwe njenge-pie chart (ngaphandle kwenani lezincwadi noma isamba, kuphela osayizi bezigaba namagama ezinyanga, izigaba zibekwe kusukela enkulu), khetha konke ongakusho ngokushesha kugrafu kuphela.
z-m-15-05.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ngokuhlunga ukuthi i-circle graph ibonisa u-'inani lezincwadi' noma u-'ingxenye yeyonke.'
z-m-15-05.s.s2.hint.1: Hlunga inketho ngayinye ibe yimibuzo engaphendulwa yingxenye nemibuzo edinga ukulandelana noma inani loshintsho.

z-m-15-05.s.s2.r.a: Ukufunda ingxenye isigaba esiyithatha kuyonke kuyisici se-circle graph.

z-m-15-05.s.s2.r.b: Izigaba zibonisa kuphela ingxenye, futhi azikho inani lezincwadi noma isamba esibhaliwe. Awukwazi ukusho kugrafu kuphela ukuthi kwehle ngezincwadi ezingaki.
z-m-15-05.s.s2.o.c: Inyanga enokubolekwa okuningi phakathi kwezinyanga eziyi-6

z-m-15-05.s.s2.r.d: Izigaba zibekwe kusukela enkulu, ngakho awukwazi ukwazi ukulandelana kwezinyanga. Uma ungazi ukulandelana, kunzima nokwazi ukugeleza kokwanda nokwehla.
z-m-15-05.s.s2.explain: Ku-pie chart, ungasho izingxenye nento enkulu kakhulu ngosayizi bezigaba. U-Agasti ungu-560÷2420, okungu-23% cishe. Kodwa njengoba inani lezincwadi lingabhaliwe futhi ukulandelana kwezinyanga akwaziwa, kunzima ukusho nge-pie chart kuphela ukuthi kwehle ngezincwadi ezingaki noma ukuthi kwanda ngokuhamba kwesikhathi yini.
z-m-15-05.s.s3.prompt: Umngane odwebe i-circle graph uthi, 'Ngokubheka le grafu nje, ungabona ngokugcwele ukugeleza kokubolekwa kukhuphuka.' Bhalela umngane wakho umbono wakho, kuhlanganise lokho i-circle graph ekubonisa kahle nalokho ekubonisa kabi.

z-m-15-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ubhale kokubili lokho okungaziwa nalokho okunzima ukukwazi nge-circle graph?
z-m-15-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Kukhona isibonelo (njengengxenye ka-Agasti) esisekela umbono wakho?
z-m-15-05.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Uyixhumanise nezimo ezidinga i-line graph noma enye igrafu?
z-m-15-05.s.s3.model.0: I-circle graph ibonisa kahle iphesenti inyanga ngayinye ethatha lona kuyonke. Isibonelo, u-Agasti ungesigaba esikhulu kakhulu. Kodwa kunzima ukubona ukugeleza kokukhuphuka nokwehla njengoba izinyanga zihamba, ngakho ukubonisa ukugeleza, i-line graph engcono.
z-m-15-05.s.s3.model.1: Ku-circle graph ungasho ukuthi u-Agasti ungomkhulu kakhulu, cishe ku-23% weyonke. Kodwa ukuguquka kokwehla kuJuni nokukhuphuka futhi kuJulayi kunzima ukukuthola ngoba akukho ukulandelana noma inani lezincwadi.
z-m-15-05.s.s3.modelNote.1: Kungaba kuhle nakakhulu ukwengeza isikhumbuzo sokuthi izinto zingashintsha uma inani lezincwadi lingabhalwa nalo.

z-m-15-04.title: Isikhwama esinamabhola abomvu amaningi singesingcono?
z-m-15-04.goal: Nquma ukuthi yiluphi ulwazi odinga ukuqhathanisa amathuba, guqula ukuqhathanisa uma kuvela ulwazi olusha, bese wenza isibonelo esikhombisa ukuthi 'abaningi' ne-'kungenzeka kakhulu' akufani.
z-m-15-04.material: Kunesikhwama 가 nesikhwama 나. Uvala amehlo bese uthatha ibhola elilodwa esikhwameni ngasinye. Amabhola ahluka ngombala kuphela; usayizi nomumo wawo kuyafana. Ngumdlalo lapho unqoba uma uthatha ibhola elibomvu. Uthatha ibhola kanye kuphela, futhi awuliphindiseli.
z-m-15-04.prereq.1: Ukuqhathanisa izingxenyana ezinezinombolo ezingezansi ezihlukile (izinga lamaBanga 5-6)
z-m-15-04.s.s1.prompt: Konke esikwaziyo manje ukuthi 'isikhwama 가 sinamabhola abomvu angu-3 futhi isikhwama 나 sinamabhola abomvu angu-5.' Yini efaneleke kakhulu ukuyisho ngokuthi yisiphi isikhwama esinikeza ithuba eliphakeme lokunqoba?
z-m-15-04.s.s1.hint.0: Cabanga ukuthi kwenzekani uma kukhona amanye amabhola angu-100 nakuba abomvu bengu-3.
z-m-15-04.s.s1.hint.1: Nikeza isibonelo esisodwa sokuthi ithuba liguquka kanjani uma inani lamabhola amanye amabala liguquka, noma ngenani elifanayo lamabhola abomvu.
z-m-15-04.s.s1.o.a: Isikhwama 나 siphakeme. Sinamabhola abomvu angu-2 angeziwe.
z-m-15-04.s.s1.r.a: Uqhathanise kuphela inani lamabhola abomvu. Asikaze sazi ukuthi yimuphi umkhawulo wawo wonke amabhola obomvu.
z-m-15-04.s.s1.o.b: Isikhwama 가 siphakeme. Uma isikhwama sinamabhola ambalwa, kulula ukuthola obomvu.
z-m-15-04.s.s1.r.b: Ucabange ukuthi inani eliphelele lamabhola lincane, kodwa asinalo ulwazi lolo okwamanje. Isiqagelo esingenazizathu.
z-m-15-04.s.s1.o.c: Asikwazi ukuqhathanisa uma singazi inani eliphelele lamabhola (noma inani lamabhola amanye amabala).
z-m-15-04.s.s1.r.c: Ukhombile ukuthi ithuba linqunywa ngokubheka inani lamabhola abomvu nenani eliphelele lamabhola ndawonye.
z-m-15-04.s.s1.o.d: Obomvu bayaphuma noma abaphumi, ngakho amathuba amabili ayafana.
z-m-15-04.s.s1.r.d: Uhlulele amathuba ayafana ngoba nje kunemiphumela emibili. Inani lemiphumela efanayo akwenzi amathuba afane.
z-m-15-04.s.s1.explain: Ithuba lithola ngengxenye amabhola abomvu ayithatha kuwo wonke amabhola. Ngokwazi inani lamabhola abomvu kuphela, asazi inani eliphelele lamabhola, ngakho asikwazi ukusho ukuthi liliphi eliphezulu. Ecaleni elinjalo, kufanelekile ukuqala ngokusho 'ukuthi yini enye okufanele siyazi.'
z-m-15-04.s.s2.prompt: Kukhona ulwazi olusha. Isikhwama 가 sinamabhola aluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka angu-2 futhi isikhwama 나 sinamabhola aluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka angu-4, futhi azikho izikhwama ezinamabhola amanye amabala. Manje, esikhwameni siphi ithuba lokunqoba eliphakeme?
z-m-15-04.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ngokuthola inani eliphelele lamabhola esikhwameni ngasinye.
z-m-15-04.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala amathuba amabili njengezingxenyana, yenza izinombolo ezingezansi zifane, bese uqhathanisa osayizi bazo.
z-m-15-04.s.s2.o.a: Isikhwama 가 siphakeme. Ingxenye yamabhola abomvu kwawo wonke amabhola inkulu.
z-m-15-04.s.s2.r.a: Lesi sahlulelo siqhathanisa, njengezingxenyana, ukuthi amabhola abomvu ayingxenye yeyiphi yeyonke ezikhwameni ezimbili.
z-m-15-04.s.s2.o.b: Isikhwama 나 siphakeme. Sinamabhola abomvu amaningi, angu-5.
z-m-15-04.s.s2.r.b: Noma ngolwazi olusha, uqhathanise kuphela inani lamabhola abomvu. Hlola ukuthi inani eliphelele lamabhola liguquke yini.
z-m-15-04.s.s2.o.c: Izikhwama ezimbili ziyafana. Kuzo zombili izikhwama kukhona ibhola eli-1 elibomvu elengeziwe kunamabhola aluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka.
z-m-15-04.s.s2.r.c: Ucabange ukuthi uma umehluko phakathi kwezibalo zobomvu nezoluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka ufanayo, amathuba ayafana. Noma umehluko ufanayo, izamba ziyahluka, ngakho izingxenye zingahluka.
z-m-15-04.s.s2.o.d: Izamba zamabhola ziyahluka, ngakho asikwazi ukuqhathanisa ngisho nangemuva kokubala.
z-m-15-04.s.s2.r.d: Ucabange ukuthi asikwazi ukuqhathanisa uma izinombolo ezingezansi zihluka. Singaqhathanisa ngokwenza izinombolo ezingezansi zifane noma ngokuguqula zibe ama-decimal.
z-m-15-04.s.s2.explain: Isikhwama 가 sinabomvu abangu-3 kwabangu-5 ngokuphelele, okungu-3/5 (0.6), futhi isikhwama 나 sinabomvu abangu-5 kwabangu-9 ngokuphelele, okungu-5/9 (cishe 0.56). Ukwenza inombolo engezansi ibe ngu-45 kunika u-27/45 no-25/45, ngakho isikhwama 가 siphakeme kancane. Noma isikhwama 나 sinamabhola abomvu amaningi, ithuba lokunqoba liphakeme kusikhwama 가.
